narrative: The morning's leaf still open on the trestle desk. The light in the west panes is going. No candle is lit yet. The pen lies in the rest. Nothing is struck through. The foot of the same leaf. The question is the last line but one. Under the last sentence the paper is blank. The leaf is not folded yet.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Visible/present in Read the leaf again before folding it
